stop_boundary: This tool never executes argv; braces denote explicit substitutions, not shell syntax.
After MAP decode, read map-crc.json geometry_crc for CM; never use dmap or guess/stamp AAS checksums.
Special AAS source members are included; other shared actor/material/audio/texture resources need the separate documented recipes.
Does not compose initial strict overlays or reproduce nativefix-v12/earliest per-map overlays.
No predecessor ports are required to render this plan or its listed raw structural stages.
Full final-package equivalence and gameplay acceptance remain unproved.
